notes.title: Harthorn: Spring Cleaning Update
notes.notes:
Harthorn has been revisited to add and fix some things not in the original release. That patch is now live with the changes below!

Some of the additions:

Doors now have UI titles for easier navigation around the school 
The 'janky' shadows the original had are all fixed
Cleaner animations on some GameObjects
Death screen with restart prompt more simplified and clean
Rooms are better labeled with signs outside the door
Simplified colliders to 'catch' less when walking by GameObjects
Debug notifications in the console decreased substantially (this file could get large in the original) 

Some of the bug fixes: 

Fixed issues with some connections between lights and light switches
Fixed Mesh Rendering issue on some lights
Fixed LOD issues on some GameObjects
Fixed missing wall collider in "Morning Shift"
Fixed Occlusion Culling issue on some carpets
Fixed fade-in-out animation to fit all screen dimensions 
Fixed clipping issue on multiple GameObjects
Fixed shadows issues on many GameObjects
Fixed "Prone" error messages in console
Fixed "Jump" error messages in console 

Extra:

New Trailer (now live)

- V

notes.title: Harthorn: Patch 03
notes.notes:
The new patch fixes several bugs that have been noticed by players:

Fixed movement issues with metal shelf mesh colliders
Fixed the chance of freezing on being tackled by the Antagonist in the North Wing
Fixed issues with triggering "Examine" on the bomb puzzle note


The patch also moves/adds several story events that I feel better explain events around Harthorn:

Fixed missing important story dialog in the South Wing by doing objectives in the wrong order
Moved important dialog from Condemned East Wing to Condemned West Wing to not having repeating dialog on death

Some minor adjustments but will enhance gameplay (in particularly: not getting caught on shelves, missing important story moments, and rehearing the same dialog on dying).

VL

notes.title: Harthorn: Patch 02
notes.notes:
Another patch for Harthorn that adds and fixes a couple things:


 Added a crosshair that changes on dynamic objects
 Larger hitbox to pick up objects
 Increased Interact Distance on objects
 Bug fixes to South Wing and Safety At Last
 Optimized some textures


More patches will roll in over time to consistently improve the game.

- VL

notes.title: Harthorn: Patch 01
notes.notes:
Some quick fixes added to Harthorn based on player feedback, the big ones being the pressure plate puzzle and the battle with Victor.

 General: Audio balancing on UI elements
 Morning Shift: Fixed intro that caused delayed movement at beginning
 Late Night Call: Audio balancing
 Condemned North Wing: Audio balancing
 Condemned West Wing: Fixed library door
 Condemned East Wing: Better diagram to solve pressure plate riddle
 Condemned East Wing: Fixed bug related to pressure plate timing
 Final Encounter: Updated pistol description
 Final Encounter: Decreased health of Victor substantially (he was harder than expected, props to those that took him down before the update hah)

More updates to come as feedback comes in and as I iron things out, thanks to everyone reporting bugs.

- VL
